title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences

result.label: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
result.statement: Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of ℚ p correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic étale fundamental group. It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over ℚ for the modular curves X0(N) and X1(N) of genus at least two.
